column1: # Drag x Drive (Switch 2, update v196608). Plays on the Mac with a pair of Joy-Con 2s over Bluetooth LE (the launcher's Switch 2 controllers setting).
# Nintendo EPD's engine (sead / agl / gsys, Phive, Havok), SDK 20.5.6, NVN2; modules main + sdk. Packed from its NUP by scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py.
# The values below are the survey's (dm/games/profile_guess.py), unchanged after play, except the NVN keys at the end.
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 9216 MB heap region
# the sdk is built for the Switch 2 (spec: Ounce): its 9 GB pool
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# Four-byte command tickets for a lone direct indexed draw (PR #1609, issue #1580): the host records such a draw in 48 bytes where the console needs 4, and a game that sizes
# its model scratch from nvnCommandBufferGetCommandMemoryUsed can outgrow a fixed resource budget. Without them this game initializes a buffer in no memory pool 5 s after boot

# ([RED] BufferInitialize: pool has no storage) and crashes in nvnMemoryPoolGetFlags; the same host with the tickets turned off (#1609's switch) crashes there, with them on it played. Ignored without PR #1609
# Conditional rendering evaluated at replay, as in every session played; not measured without it
